infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OAM uses your camera so you can photograph items to sell and submit verification documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OAM needs access to your photos so you can upload listing images and verification documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: OAM saves receipt images and shared files to your photo library when you choose to.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OAM uses your microphone when you record a short video of your work for artisan verification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OAM uses your location to show artisans, listings and services near you.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: OAM uses Face ID to protect your wallet and confirm sensitive account actions.
